findings.details: The sourceClassification graph now gathers a source unit, runs the model seam, waits for review, and rechecks current authority, but the final routes.commit capability referenced by the graph is not present in the Confect capability tree. The task only adds pure review/commit helper functions and tests, so the declared reviewed-route commit API and its StaleGeneration/DuplicateEffect failure paths are not reachable from the workflow contract. This prevents S08-T03 from satisfying the required mechanical route capability call and the end-to-end typed failure contract.
